definition_en: The ability to generate novel ideas, approaches, or solutions, and to apply imagination and originality to solve problems or create value.
definition_ms: Keupayaan untuk menghasilkan idea, pendekatan atau penyelesaian baharu, serta menggunakan imaginasi dan keaslian bagi menyelesaikan masalah.
typical_tasks_en:
• Design three alternative onboarding formats for remote interns.
• Come up with a low-cost campaign idea to promote the new organic product line.
• Propose a new layout for the customer queue system to reduce waiting time.
typical_tasks_ms:
• Reka tiga format orientasi alternatif untuk pelatih jarak jauh.
• Hasilkan idea kempen kos rendah untuk mempromosikan barisan produk organik baharu.
• Cadangkan susun atur baharu untuk sistem giliran pelanggan bagi mengurangkan masa menunggu.
inclusion_rules:
• The task requires generating new ideas or solutions
• The task involves designing something that does not yet exist
• The task requires finding unconventional approaches to a problem
• The task involves brainstorming or ideation
• The task requires combining existing concepts in new ways
exclusion_rules:
• The task involves only applying established procedures or templates
• The user is reproducing existing designs without modification
• The task requires strict compliance with fixed specifications
• The user is copying or replicating work without original input
insufficient_context_rule: Return insufficient_context=true when the task asks for output but gives no signal of originality, ideation, or new approach.

confusions.boundary_rule: Creative thinking is broad idea generation. Design applies creative ideas to solve specific user problems with usability constraints.
confusions.example_task: Invent a new way for elderly patients to book appointments online.
confusions.expected_labels: Creative thinking; Design and user experience

confusions.boundary_rule: Creative thinking generates ideas. Marketing applies those ideas to promote and reach audiences.
confusions.example_task: Come up with a creative concept for the holiday social media campaign.

confusions.boundary_rule: Creative thinking generates new ideas. Analytical thinking evaluates evidence and existing information.
confusions.example_task: Analyse sales data and then brainstorm new product ideas from the findings.

examples.task_text: Design three alternative onboarding formats for remote interns.
examples.reason: Requires generating novel solutions for a process.

examples.task_text: Come up with a low-cost campaign idea to promote the new organic product line.
examples.evidence: Come up with a low-cost campaign idea

examples.task_text: Apply the company's standard invoice template to this month's billing.
examples.reason: Using an established template without original creation.
